summary: The note is a short biographical entry on Mildrith, presented as the daughter of King Merewalh of Magonsaete, a sub-kingdom of Mercia. Her mother is given as Domne Eafe, also sometimes named as Saint Eormenburga, who was the great granddaughter of King Æthelberht of Kent. Through this lineage Mildrith appears in the so-called Kentish Royal Legend.
one_line: Mildrith, daughter of King Merewalh of Magonsaete and Domne Eafe, appears in the Kentish Royal Legend.
